title: Saray Managtraidor ed saray Pinili
intro: Diad interon awaran, saray madibinon mensahero so nanakar ed limog na katooan, tan pigara ed saray sankaasinggeran ed sikara so agmakabidbir ed liwawa. Sayan salaysay et nipaakar ed duaran kamarerwa ya say inkaapit da ed inkapropeta so nagmaliw a subok ed sikara, tan say legasiya ra so nagmaliw ya agnaparaan a leksion.
clues: Nambilay itayo ed panaon na saray bantog a propeta, balet ta ag tayo nanengneng so katuaan ya inawit da.
Saray kaabungan mi so napno na madibinon panangiparungtal, balet saray kapusoan mi so inmawet.
Kasal kami na lalakin pinilin mamasakbay ed saray totoo ra.
Nen sinmabi so dusa, ag kami nananap na salimbengan ed biong tan ag kami binmatik ed mandarlang ya uran, lapud inelek-elekan mi ray pasakbay.
Sikatayo so abitla ed Quran bilang alimbawa parad saramay ag manisia, ya mangipapanengneng ya anggan say maapit a relasyon ed sakey a propeta et ag makapangiliktar.
Sikami so asawa nen Nuh tan Lut, ya angitapat ed sikara kanian asentensiaan ira.

identity.label: Siopa Sikatayo?
options: Saray asawa nen Nuh tan Lut
Saray asawa di Ibrahim tan Isma'il
Saray asawa nen Musa tan Harun
Saray asawa nen Dawud tan Sulayman
Saray asawa di Ayyub tan Yunus
identity.answer: Saray asawa nen Nuh tan Lut

trial.label: Antoy bista ed sikara?
options: Sikaray akiasawa ed saray propeta balet ag ira manisia
Sikaray lepes tan binalaw da ray propeta
Mayaman tan mapaatagey ira
Sikaray tinukso nen Iblis ya taynanan so kaabungan da
Inggalang da so Balitok a Baka
trial.answer: Sikaray akiasawa ed saray propeta balet ag ira manisia

location.label: Antoy koneksion na kapalaran da?
options: Say delap tan say uran na bato
Mabiskeg a dagem
Sakey a yegyeg
Say salot na saray duron
Say inkaapag na dayat
location.answer: Say delap tan say uran na bato

outcome.label: Antoy anggaan da?
options: Inatey ira a kaiba iray agmananisia
Nagbabawi ira tan nilaban ira
Sikaray atilak ya andiay anak
Sikaray nibantak ed andi-anggaan
Sikaray nagmaliw ya unggoy tan baboy
outcome.answer: Inatey ira a kaiba iray agmananisia

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
